## WORK-GAO-FIBRES-20261113

**Review F4/F6/F7 surjectivity proofs and settle the remaining three-point and F5 gates**

**Disposition:** archived-programme. **Kind:** review. **Compute class:** bounded-replay.

**Next step:** Only3+2+2+2 remains for a three-point F7 fibre, now necessarily with D0=s*(3s^3-2)!=0: GAOF7TRP1 completely classifies the four pole curves (288 seven-point,23 eight-point targets, all others nine). The global coefficient problem has two newly transported five-variable branches via delta=-2h-3r*u+3r*z-u*z+2v+z^2. Retain both branches and every w-recovery denominator. Delta-zero modular unit output is triage; the30second rational lift exported no identity. Its low-six-equation support has1024 terms but did not improve modular unit time, so do not retry unchanged. Saturated delta-nonzero hit20seconds. Next derive a smaller literal rational identity support, a carrier-power target usable off the closed pole chart, or a certified finite projector; an exact example is equally valid. Do not repeat old six-variable searches or enlarge caps unchanged. Independent end-to-end review of all18 Gao results, full F7 strata,F5 and broad JC2/HC4 remain outstanding. Any proposed example must replay simple-root lifting and prove the residual S3 squarefree and disjoint from the marked and squared cubic factors; a point of the broader working ideal alone is not a three-point witness.

**Completion evidence:** Written classifications, F7 surjectivity and the new partial/elliptic/height results receive independent end-to-end review or corrected scopes; F7 three-point existence and remaining strata are decided by exact certificates; F5 has complete lifting and boundary analysis. Finite boxes, modular outputs, incomplete bases or unconnected geometric structure are not exclusions.

**Prerequisites and boundary:** GAOF4FIB1/ELL1/NP1 and GAOF6FIB1/NP1 give complete complex cardinalities and nonproper loci. GAOF7BND1/CARD1/NP1/SURJ1 establish boundary counts, ten occurring sizes,11 impossible, the nonproper locus and surjectivity, leaving only cardinality3 undecided. GAOF7THREE1/CUBE1/MULT1/FIVE1 give exhaustive multiplicity reductions, no cubed cubic divisor, sharp maximum multiplicity5 and all118 fivefold targets. GAOF7CUSP1/MW1 give elliptic auxiliary geometry and dense rational points without solving the fibre gate. GAOF7FOUR1 establishes the generic degree8 quadruple model and finite degenerations. GAOF7FOUR2 now completes all quadruple strata:912 six-point and118 seven-point targets,1030 nonordinary normalized targets, every presentation pole covered, and4+3+2 excluded. Only3+2+2+2 remains for a three-point fibre. GAOF7TRP1 completes the triple-root pole chart as four disjoint closed Gm curves and reduces the sole remaining three-point case to D0!=0. Its exact norm projections have degrees72 and216; all311 nonordinary pole targets are counted without duplicate marked roots.
